counting_rule: Two new exact uses do not imply two new molecules. Four existing candidates were reviewed; only BLU, enasidenib and KCNMA1 receive material new primary-evidence deltas. Published experiments are historical source evidence, not experiments conducted in this sprint.

delta: Adult C2α genetic inactivation shows a stress susceptibility missed by baseline assessment; a tested isolated-cell system also failed to reproduce the organismal liability. This is not measured BLU toxicity or a partial-inhibition threshold.
C2β WT/kinase-defective add-back in a tumor model separates protein/scaffold consequences from catalytic lipid-product effects. Exact perturbations and replicate units remain distinct.

A newly retrieved primary Myology2024 abstract reports discordant myogenic, calcium, 3D morphology and RyR findings in its tested systems. Model line, genotype, maturity and functional endpoint provenance remain necessary; L463S residual function and model-specific negative sensitivity are unresolved.

Retain the affirmative bounded first-proof recommendation and 55 planning points. Additional manual interpretation requirements do not change the proposed numeric thresholds or establish a systemic therapeutic window.

A primary TGA2025 assessment adds the active vorasidenib metabolite AGI-69460 exposure issue. A late-cycle mean molar predose metabolite:parent ratio is not a normal infant-brain exposure measure or AUC ratio.

The cited assessment did not establish metabolite animal brain penetration and excluded it from the population PK model; observed adolescent representation was one patient under18. Metabolite R140Q potency and unbound normal-infant-brain exposure remain unresolved.
Retain enasidenib rank2 and15 planning points. Cardiac benefit, neurological treatment and neonatal prevention remain separate; parent-only exposure comparisons cannot establish CNS superiority.
Bounded public-source comparator review found no new verified rank-changing HHD evidence beyond the preserved dossiers. Retain rank3 and10 planning points.
Keep exact1.5% article, concurrent-care comparison, all-randomized and maintenance denominators, exposure and useful pain/erosion/rescue-burden outcomes. No new HHD efficacy observation is claimed.
New-to-repository controlled mouse pharmacology adds plausibility without repairing human responder selection or exact-article transfer.
